verdict.rationale: Reducto publishes a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec and llms.txt-driven docs with markdown mirrors, code snippets (client.parse.run examples), and agent-oriented reference pages, which supports API discoverability for AI-native workflows. However, there's no direct evidence of an interactive 'try it now' console or runnable-in-browser examples (e.g., Swagger UI-style playground) — only static code snippets and a machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-docs interactive playground/sandbox, evidence of live 'run this example' execution, and independent confirmation of the reference's interactivity beyond static snippets.
